pages.title: Fortnite Loot Llama with Upright Ears, Layered Paper Fringe, a Bridle, and Its Familiar Saddle Pouch Coloring Page
pages.description: A Fortnite Loot Llama fills this printable coloring page, showing upright ears, layered paper fringe, a bridle, and a buckled saddle pouch against an open background. Its angular snout and blocky hooves create a clear silhouette. The coloring sheet offers many separate fringe panels alongside larger areas on the head and bag.

pages.title: Fortnite Supply Llama Perched in a Tree While Jonesy Builds Wooden Stairs to Reach It Coloring Page
pages.description: Jonesy builds wooden stairs toward a Supply Llama perched in a tree on this printable coloring page, holding his pickaxe as he looks up. The llama stands on a thick branch with an arrow-marked pouch at its side. Plank grain, leafy branches, and distant pine trees add varied detail throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Fortnite Supply Llama with Raven Sneaking Toward It Inside a Bush Disguise Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page pairs a Fortnite Supply Llama with Raven sneaking through a bush disguise, his hooded face and gloved hands visible among the leaves. The llama's layered fringe and hanging pouch occupy the foreground. Rocks, grass tufts, and a pine tree give the coloring sheet distinct background sections to color.

pages.title: Fortnite Loot Llama Beside Jonesy Using a Medkit Under a Wooden Shelter as the Storm Approaches Coloring Page
pages.description: A Loot Llama stands beside Jonesy using a medkit under a wooden shelter on this printable coloring page, with the approaching storm visible beyond the opening. Jonesy kneels with the cross-marked case open in his hands. The coloring sheet contrasts long shelter planks and llama fringe with rounded clouds and distant hillside buildings.

pages.title: Fortnite Supply Llama on a Hill with Cuddle Team Leader Landing Nearby Beneath Her Glider Coloring Page
pages.description: Cuddle Team Leader descends beneath her glider beside a hilltop Supply Llama on this printable coloring page, with mountains and pine trees extending into the distance. Her bear hood, broken-heart emblem, and laced boots provide smaller details. The llama's fringe, rocky hillside, and broad glider canopy divide this coloring sheet into varied shapes.

pages.title: Fortnite Supply Llama Beside a Treasure Chest and a Parachute Supply Crate in an Island Loot Cache Coloring Page
pages.description: A Supply Llama stands beside a treasure chest on this printable coloring page, while a parachute supply crate hangs above an island shoreline dotted with palms. The chest has a large keyhole, riveted bands, and a ring handle. Repeated llama fringe contrasts with open water and broad parachute panels in the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Fortnite Birthday Llama with a Cake Emblem on Its Saddle Pouch Beside Birthday Balloons and a Cake Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Fortnite Birthday Llama with a cake emblem on its saddle pouch, surrounded by balloon clusters and a candle-topped birthday cake. Confetti rectangles scatter across the ground beneath its blocky hooves. The coloring sheet mixes broad balloon shapes with small sprinkles, buckles, and repeated layers of paper fringe.

pages.title: Fortnite Llama Releasing Cards Amid Confetti Coloring Page
pages.description: A Fortnite Birthday Llama releases hero and schematic cards on this printable coloring page, with two celebrating characters, balloons, and bunting marking the Homebase birthday scene. Its side pouch swings open beneath the floating cards. Confetti, outfit straps, and layered fringe add smaller sections around the larger figures on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Fortnite Christmas Loot Llama Wearing a Santa Hat with a Wrapped Present Tucked Into Its Side Pouch Coloring Page
pages.description: A Christmas Loot Llama wears a Santa hat on this printable coloring page, with a bow-topped present tucked into the open pouch at its side. Upright ears rise above the fluffy hat trim, and layered fringe covers its body. The coloring sheet leaves a plain background around the large figure and its smaller buckle details.

pages.title: Fortnite Llama Beside a Dragon Weapon Diagram Coloring Page
pages.description: Dragon Scorch examines a dragon weapon schematic beside a Lunar Llama on this printable coloring page, kneeling beneath a row of hanging festival lanterns. The scroll shows a dragon-headed weapon with inset detail drawings. Armor panels, paper fringe, lantern ribs, and floorboards supply a mix of shapes across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Fortnite Rad Llama Beside Dennis Jr. Testing a Boombox Weapon at a Concert Sound Check Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Dennis Jr. testing a boombox weapon beside a Rad Llama during a concert sound check, with sound waves leaving its speaker. Stacked speakers and overhead stage lights frame the pair. Small outfit straps and speaker rings contrast with the llama's broad fringe panels on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Fortnite Art Deco Llama with a Side Lockbox Beside Geometric Treasure Chests in an Art Deco Vault Coloring Page
pages.description: An Art Deco Llama stands inside a geometric vault on this printable coloring page, beside patterned treasure chests and a small lockbox with a combination dial. A large round vault door and diamond motifs fill the background. Straight borders, circular bands, and overlapping fringe give this coloring sheet many distinct sections.

pages.title: Fortnite Llama Wearing a Top Hat and Chains Coloring Page
pages.description: A Legendary Troll Stash Llama wears a small top hat and heavy chains on this printable coloring page, standing among heaps of star-marked reward cards. A round llama medallion hangs over its layered chest fringe. The coloring sheet pairs broad body panels with close chain links and neatly stacked card edges.

pages.title: Fortnite Mini Reward Llama Beside a Full-size Llama on the Homebase Mission Reward Table Coloring Page
pages.description: A Mini Reward Llama stands beside a full-size llama on this printable coloring page, with both figures displayed on the Homebase mission reward table beneath a map. Their arrow-marked pouches and upright ears repeat at different scales. Crates and storage cases add straight-edged background areas around the fringed figures in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Fortnite Llama Beneath a Hammer with Sparks Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page places an Upgrade Llama beneath the unboxing hammer, with an upward-arrow saddle emblem and sharp upgrading sparks surrounding its head and ears. The raised hammer has a broad block-shaped head and wrapped handle. Open background space sets off the layered fringe and small buckles on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Fortnite Loot Llama with Character and Weapon Cards Coloring Page
pages.description: A Smorgasbord Llama appears with branching hero and schematic reward choices on this printable coloring page, surrounded by portrait cards and drawings of a pickaxe and rifle. Curved arrows point outward from its head toward the cards. The coloring sheet combines repeated fringe shapes with smaller faces, equipment outlines, and ground stones.

pages.title: Fortnite Classic Loot Llama Pinata Hanging From a Tree at a Fortnite Birthday Party Coloring Page
pages.description: A classic Loot Llama pinata hangs from a tree on this printable coloring page, above two characters celebrating a Fortnite birthday party beneath balloons and bunting. One character raises a pickaxe while the other clasps her hands. The coloring sheet includes rope twists, layered fringe, knee pads, and broad leafy tree shapes.

pages.title: Fortnite Llama in Reality Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Fortnite Llama among the spreading branches of the Reality Tree, with curling vines and leaves surrounding its tall upright ears. A crescent moon and stars decorate its side pouch. Broad body sections and tree limbs contrast with small buckles, leaf veins, and floating circles in the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Fortnite Llama in Lonely Labs Coloring Page
pages.description: A Fortnite Llama stands at snowy Lonely Labs on this printable coloring page, wearing a star pendant and a saddle pouch beneath distant mountains and satellite dishes. Small research buildings and connecting cables fill the background. The coloring sheet offers large body panels with finer details in the antennas, pouch lettering, and pine trees.

pages.title: Fortnite Llama in Military Base Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Fortnite Llama at a military base, with star decorations, a rolled bedroll, and a buckled side pouch on its harness. Tents, sandbags, wooden crates, and a watchtower establish the camp setting. The coloring sheet mixes broad fur sections with small equipment shapes and straight architectural lines.

pages.title: Fortnite Llama in Retail Row Coloring Page
pages.description: A Fortnite Llama stands in Retail Row on this printable coloring page, with a diamond-patterned body, a pickaxe chest badge, and a double-buckled saddle pouch. Shop windows, a NOMS sign, and a curved streetlight frame the scene. The coloring sheet combines repeated geometric panels with broad sidewalk sections and smaller storefront details.

pages.title: Fortnite Llama in Slappy Shores Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page places a Fortnite Llama in Slappy Shores, wearing geometric bands and a side pouch marked with a large F beside factory buildings. Pipes, a tank, and a small waterside walkway fill the background. Diamonds, triangles, a stitched patch, and broad body panels create varied sections on the coloring sheet.
